subject: mathematics
title: Shape Trail · Q1 W01 D01
objective: Recognize and describe points, lines, line segments, rays, and special line relationships.
introduction: Milo has a new mission! 🐱✨ A point marks a location. A line segment has two endpoints. A ray has one endpoint and continues in one direction.

activities.instruction: Listen to the explanation about number skills.
activities.content: A point marks a location. A line segment has two endpoints. A ray has one endpoint and continues in one direction. Parallel lines do not meet; perpendicular lines meet to form a right angle. Try the skill with books on a classroom shelf.
